categories.main_business_segments: DAIHO Corporation operates primarily in three business segments: Civil Engineering, Building Construction, and Other Businesses. The Civil Engineering segment focuses on public and private infrastructure projects, the Building Construction segment covers a wide range of architectural projects including residential, commercial, and industrial facilities, and the Other Businesses segment includes real estate, painting, and construction material leasing through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company is known for its proprietary shield tunneling and pneumatic caisson construction methods, with numerous patents such as the NewDREAM method for unmanned high-pressure underground construction. It actively develops automation, digitalization (DX), and BIM-based productivity enhancements, as well as eco-friendly technologies like low-carbon concrete and energy-efficient building systems. The company also invests in advanced seismic isolation, foundation, and environmental remediation technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: DAIHO serves both public sector clients (government agencies, municipalities) and private sector customers (developers, manufacturers, logistics, healthcare, and commercial entities). Its end markets include infrastructure (roads, tunnels, waterworks), large-scale residential and commercial buildings, logistics facilities, and environmental projects, with a balanced mix of public and private contracts.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Japan, with a nationwide branch network covering all major regions. It also has overseas operations, particularly in Southeast Asia (notably Thailand) and some projects in Africa (e.g., Madagascar), with overseas sales accounting for a small but growing portion of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: DAIHO is positioned as a downstream player in the construction supply chain, acting as a general contractor responsible for project management, design, and execution, while subcontracting specialized work and sourcing materials and equipment from upstream suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening human capital, transforming the business structure, and investing in R&D and DX (digital transformation). The company is focused on expanding maintenance/renovation, PPP/PPP projects, and ESG-related businesses (renewable energy, environmental solutions), while deepening its core technologies in shield and pneumatic caisson construction. R&D emphasizes automation, digitalization, environmental sustainability, and productivity improvements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through fixed-price and competitive-bid construction contracts for civil engineering and building projects, with additional income from real estate development, leasing, and construction material rentals. Revenue recognition is based on the percentage-of-completion method for long-term contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: DAIHO competes with major Japanese general contractors (such as Obayashi, Kajima, Shimizu, and Taisei) and mid-sized construction firms. It differentiates itself through specialized underground construction technologies and a strong presence in both civil engineering and building construction, but is smaller in scale compared to the largest industry players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated net sales were ¥143.4 billion, with operating profit of ¥5.5 billion and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of ¥3.7 billion. The company has around 1,700 consolidated employees and targets ¥160 billion in sales and ¥6.7 billion in operating profit by FY2027. After a temporary earnings dip in FY2024, profitability recovered in FY2025, and the company is pursuing stable, moderate growth with a focus on profitability and capital efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: DAIHO emphasizes its advanced underground construction technologies (shield tunneling, pneumatic caisson), high safety and quality standards, and ability to deliver complex infrastructure and building projects. Its value proposition includes technical expertise, reliability, and a commitment to sustainability and digital innovation, aiming to be a trusted partner for both public and private sector clients.
